label: Marco Rubio
narrative: Rubio matters here because of what he had access to. As Vice Chairman of the Senate Select Committee on Intelligence from February 2021 until he resigned his seat in January 2025 to become Secretary of State, he was one of eight people in the country entitled to be briefed on everything, and he used that position to say repeatedly and on the record that the accounts were coming from serious people. In March 2021, then already SSCI Vice Chair, he told Fox Business that objects were flying over military installations and that 'It isn't ours. It isn't anything that's registered to the FAA, and in many cases exhibits attributes of things we've never seen.' He was an original cosponsor of S.Amdt. 797 on 13 July 2023, the only member of the Gang of Eight other than Schumer to put his name on the eminent domain text. In February 2023 he co-led the sixteen-senator push with Gillibrand to fully fund AARO. His departure from the Senate in January 2025 removed the disclosure coalition's most senior intelligence-committee Republican, and the collapse of UAP provisions in the FY2026 and FY2027 authorization cycles begins immediately after it.
